name: prompt-timeline
description: Draws your own prompts as a distinct card in the transcript and adds /timeline, a pane listing your prompts that jumps to any of them.

restyle_output.title: Restyle the transcript
restyle_output.description: Draw prompts, replies, tool calls and their output in this plugin's own look. Off keeps Claude Code's default display; the panes, the prompt strip and startup notices stay either way.
